short_description: Calculate evidence-backed TAM, SAM, and SOM.
description: Size markets with top-down, bottom-up, and value-theory methods using current, cited public evidence.

requires: Authorized SandBase connection for capability calls

install.prompt: Use $market-sizing-analysis to estimate TAM, SAM, and SOM with cited assumptions.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill market-sizing-analysis --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill market-sizing-analysis --agent codex --global

examples: Size the US market for this B2B product.
Cross-check a bottom-up estimate against current market reports.
notes: Call sandbase_inspect before each capability and pass only current schema-defined arguments.
Do not mutate external systems without explicit user authorization.

schema_resolution.dynamic_lookup: Use tool_name as a discovery hint with sandbase_discover; pass the matching returned name to sandbase_inspect and follow execute_as with the current inputSchema.

endpoints.summary: Find semantically relevant high-quality web sources.
